decisions.decision: ReleasePreparation is conditional after SystemVerification, while ReleaseVerificationGate remains Core-owned and separate before BusinessAcceptance.
One immutable candidate identity binds exact source, approved baselines, version, policy, toolchain, configuration, owner intent, and current environment readiness.
Native Node and Windows candidate capabilities ship behind provider-neutral materialize, inspect, verify, attest, and prerequisite-probe ports; optional adapters remain bounded by proven maturity.
Core checkpoints exact prepared candidate bytes before progression, and exact replay reuses them with zero packaging, download, signing, upload, tag, publication, or branch effects.
Verification reloads stored candidate bytes and evaluates every obligation under one versioned release and supply-chain policy; rebuilds and adapter self-certification are invalid.
Release execution is offline and project-local by default and has no implicit credential, tag, publication, deployment, hosted-release, or protected-main authority.
Trusted contributors derive forward-only candidate and approved release traceability from validated artifacts; adapters remain graph-blind.
